rv.q: It is the smallest of blips in an otherwise magnificent production.
In all it’s a bold spectacle but I’m still dubious about what it can say to us today, apart from the obvious.

cn.t: Mark Gatiss terrifies in his RSC debut as Brecht's fascistic demagogue, delivering a performance critics praise as both timely and powerful. The production earns acclaim for its circus-like staging and chilling contemporary resonance.
